passages.language-acquisition: Language acquisition involves the process through which humans develop the ability to understand and produce language. Children aro___ the wo___ follow sim____ developmental sta___, regardless o_ what spec____ language th__ are lear____. They fi___ babble, prog____ to single words, and eventually construct complex sentences. questions.prompt: Question 21: complete aro___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：und → around。around the worldは「世界中の」。世界各地の子供を指します。

questions.prompt: Question 22: complete wo___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：rld → world。the worldは「世界」。aroundと組み合わさって範囲を示します。

questions.prompt: Question 23: complete sim____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ilar → similar。similar developmental stagesは「似た発達段階」。similarが後ろの名詞句を修飾します。

questions.prompt: Question 24: complete sta___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ges → stages。stagesは「段階」。後文の喃語・単語・複雑な文という段階的な説明に対応します。

questions.prompt: Question 25: complete o_. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：f → of。regardless ofは「〜に関係なく」。ofが必要な定型表現です。

questions.prompt: Question 26: complete spec____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ific → specific。what specific languageは「具体的にどの言語か」。どの言語を学んでいてもという文脈です。

questions.prompt: Question 27: complete th__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ey → they。theyは前のChildrenを受けます。they are learningで進行形を作ります。

questions.prompt: Question 28: complete lear____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ning → learning。areの後ろで進行形なのでlearning。「学んでいる」という意味です。

questions.prompt: Question 29: complete fi___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：rst → first。firstは「最初に」。eventually「最終的に」と対比して発達の順序を示します。

questions.prompt: Question 30: complete prog____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ress → progress。progress toは「〜へ進む」。They babble, progress, and constructと動詞の原形が並びます。
